## Re-measurement at source, replacing the deleted triage comment

`domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat · session `session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S` · 2026-09-24T05:47Z · objectui `origin/main` `62597c5` · read with `git show` / `git grep` on `origin/main`, never the working tree. Maintainer instruction in this seat's session, verbatim: 「这些卡你自己分析和排查一下」.

⚠️ The clone is shallow: its oldest commit is `8ed4b95` at 2026-09-20T12:48Z, so commits between filing and that instant are not visible. ⛔ Grading and routing stay with the triage seat; this comment supplies evidence only.

**Verdict: CONFIRMED, now documented and pinned as deliberate.** It is still silent when the app runs.

- Declared: the injected `ELEMENT_DATA_SOURCE_INPUT` (`packages/core/src/data-scope/element-data-source.ts:499-505`, 「{ object, view, filter, sort, limit }」), injected at `core/src/registry/Registry.ts:435-436`. Spec `page.zod.ts` has `sort: z.array(SortItemSchema).optional()`, and so does the published 17.4.0 build.
- Dropped: `packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx:447` `OBJECT_KANBAN_DATA_SOURCE` maps only `filter` and `limit`. ElementDataSourceGate applies `sort` only when the mapping names it (`ElementDataSourceGate.tsx:278,311`). `ObjectKanban.tsx:675-676` builds `$filter` and `$top` but no `$orderby`. Lit control on the same grep: `$top` and `$filter` hit; `sort`/`orderby` get 0 hits outside comments.
- Changed since filing: `index.tsx:442-446` now documents the drop, and `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts:2439` pins 「no `$orderby` and no `sort` reaches the query」. No runtime warning exists; the gate warns only on `limit` (`:344-346`).
- Class: user-reachable (an authored sort is silently ignored). Implement versus warn loudly is a product call; a gate-level warning for any present-but-unmapped binding member would cover every block. `Clause-②: no`. Size S (warn) or M (implement).
- vs #10069: same file, different regions and mechanisms. Serial, not foldable.
